annotations.title: Update the name or the external identifier of a job role in an organization

description: Update the name or the external identifier of a job role in an organization. Members keep the job role and its competencies.

id.description: external unique job role identifier, empty string removes it

job.description: name of the job role (or its external identifier if no job role has this name)

title.description: new name of the job role, must be unique within the organization

name: edubase_patch_organization_job
